summary.text: Chris Gorsek is a Democratic member of the Oregon State Senate for District 25, which his legislative page associates with Gresham.
He describes himself as an educator and former police officer and is co-chair of the Joint Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Gorsek says he has taught geography and law enforcement at Mount Hood Community College since 1996.
He also served as a police officer with the Portland Police Bureau for seven years, patrolling neighborhoods on the east side of Portland.
He and his wife, Jackie, live in Gresham after living in Troutdale for 20 years.
In the legislature, he is co-chair of the Joint Transportation Committee and of the Oregon Legislative Rail Caucus, according to his biography.

Among accomplishments he lists are updating the Oregon Strategic Investment Program, funding for a Gresham youth drug- and gang-prevention program, and a law, developed with the Center on Wrongful Convictions of Youth, that prohibits lying to children in interrogations and requires recording of youth interviews.
